description:
Inspect and refactor client-server synchronization to eliminate latency and state discrepancies:
- Address stale client-side overwrites where mutation responses overwrite updated subscription states.
- Evaluate pushing fully updated aim/phase payloads in WebSocket events instead of triggering client-side query round-trips.
- Investigate parallelizing server-side file listing to speed up full-project loads.
- Explore sequence numbers/versions for resource atoms to prevent out-of-order updates.
reflection: Synchronization refactor now covers both aim and phase response ordering. Earlier work added monotonic per-aim client request revisions so delayed mutation responses cannot overwrite fresher subscription state. This slice adds the same per-resource revision guard for phase fetches and move mutation responses, routes subscription phase refreshes through the guarded loader, and routes post-commit phase reloads through it. Regression tests explicitly resolve a subscription refresh before a stale phase mutation response. Verification: focused MultiClient tests 4/4, full frontend unit suite 214/214, frontend vue-tsc type-check, and git diff check pass.

status.comment: Stale aim and phase mutation/subscription overwrite races are fixed and tested. Broader payload-push and measured load-performance work remain.
